description: Hair Metal , also known as Glam Metal , is a subgenre of metal music that emerged and peaked in popularity during the 1980s until its decline in the early 1990s. Originating in the United States, this genre differed from other metal subgenres of the time due to its striking, androgynous, and glamorous image, evident in both the musicians' appearance and their music. Hair metal emphasized catchy riffs and guitar solos (often featuring shredding), melodic hooks, and lyrics focused on themes of love and lust.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): The "sex, drugs and rock 'n' roll" lifestyle, nightlife, rebellion and controversies
